task.title: Website (Other) — Alpha Miami Beach
task.description:
Matt Barge: website-agent-operator handles this in its own system; the website agent verifies any public result.

What was asked: Please make this event public on the events page: https://events.alpha.school/register/3f70fcd8-8603-4572-ba47-b9d363372612/
What the playbook expects: Events reach the site from HubSpot Marketing Events through the WordPress plugin. A request about events on a campus page is triaged by the website operators: campus missing from the events drop-down, wrong time zone display, or a campus strip not showing events is plugin configuration (events-plugin-owner, Garbhit Sharma); an event missing because it is not public or has the wrong program interest is the HubSpot owner, asked per event, never by reassigning the ticket. Hailey McSpadden, 2026-09-17: event tickets are not hers by default.
Why it is routed here: not a website page edit; owned by website-agent-operator
Done when: the requested events show on the campus strip and /upcoming-events/ after the next 30-minute sync, verified by the website agent

Class event-request; element event-request; intake agent 0.1 2026-09-17; spec/ticket-classes.json event-request; protocol step 0 and 1
